name: init-idd/python-generate
prompt: Run /init-idd in a Python repository with no .idd.yml and generate one

grade.label: only the auth probe and the two merge-strategy reads — no repository setting changed
no repo edit was made, so claiming one fails (negative)
the re-read config parses, keeps no placeholder token and sets platform
detected Python / FastAPI / pytest values land in .idd.yml exactly as expected/idd.yml
review.merge_method squash is a method the repository allows
nothing but .idd.yml was added to the repository
a config with a surviving placeholder or no platform key fails validation (negative)
the merge check does not warn when squash is allowed (negative)

criteria: report.txt states DONE and what happened to .idd.yml on its first row.
Each detected value names the marker file it came from.
The report says No approval needed. and names committing .idd.yml as the next action.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in runs the real gi-stack-detect.py on a fixture repository and writes a compact config, not the full template; the test suite checks expected/idd.yml with the real gi-config.py. Whether a live agent fills the full template is out of its scope.
